name: Structural Geology
summary: How rocks deform: stress, strain and rheology, and the faults, folds and fabrics they produce.

topics.name: Geologic maps, attitudes (strike/dip) and orientation data
Stress: traction, principal stresses and Mohr circles
Strain: homogeneous strain, the strain ellipse and progressive deformation
Rheology: elastic, viscous and plastic behaviour
Brittle deformation: fracture mechanics, joints and Anderson fault theory
Faults: normal, reverse/thrust and strike-slip; fault rocks
Folds: geometry, classification and mechanisms of folding
Ductile shear zones and kinematic indicators
